dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It might be bad to pick so many flowers...

dialogues.speaker: Mengmeng
dialogues.text: Ah, I'm sorry, I did a bad thing.

dialogues.speaker: Mengmeng
dialogues.text: I'm not good with my hands... I broke a lot of flower stems, and they couldn't be used to make garland...

dialogues.speaker: Mengmeng
dialogues.text: ...Well, I guess I'll just give these flowers to you!

dialogues.speaker: Mengmeng
dialogues.text: This way, they'll see some use.
